snippet.title: Wilder World: The Simulation
snippet.description:
Welcome to Wilder World, the most expansive online multiplayer metaverse ever developed. Build, explore and defend the city of Wiami—a vibrant neon-lit, cyberpunk metropolis spanning 10 districts and 100+ neighborhoods. 

Commence your Adventure: Design a unique avatar from millions of character combinations, race high-performance vehicles, build your in-game empire by extracting and utilizing resources, and battle malicious forces threatening the city’s prosperity. It’s your world now. 

Ready to enter a New Dimension of Reality?

⛓️ Sign Up for Super Early Access Now (Coming to PC in 2025):
https://wilderworld.com/earlyaccess

🎮 Wishlist on Epic Games: 
https://store.epicgames.com/en-US/p/wilder-world-5fe948 

🌐 Explore Wilder World:
Twitter | Instagram | Discord
